_comment: Log Events — authored lines that appear in the exploration log a set number of steps after the party enters a map (tutorials, descriptions that unfold as the party explores). map_id: the map. repeat: 'once' (each line shown a single time per save, default) or 'every_visit'. entries: [{ steps, text }] — steps counts moves on the map since arriving (0 = on arrival). See docs/data_dictionary/log_event.md.

entries.text: Smoke still curls from the wrecked wagons. Whoever did this left in a hurry. We should look around and find some weapons... use the arrow keys or WASD to move.
Tip: Walk over items to pick them up.
Tip: press L to open the full Adventure Log, and H for help.

Tip: press P to access the Party Screen to equip items, view characters and send found items to individual characters. Go to a character screen to equip items, use abilities and view character details.
Tip: get more experience by discovering new areas, talking to new people, reading lore and defeating enemies on the battlefield

Be careful, the sounds of beasts rustling around fills the air around you. Equip what weapons you have and try to find a way to get clear of these burning wagons. Try to find a settlement and get some help.
Welcome to your first visit to a town in Wilderstep. In towns you can find items to buy, villagers to meet, adventures to start and you can find comfort and healing.
To buy weapons, armor and other items go to the stalls located at the center of town. In these stalls, you can buy and sell items.
